project.name: SynapTable
project.summary: A local-first visual thinking canvas with WebMCP tools for organizing ideas and tables alongside an agent.
project.ai_usage: WebMCP exposes six bounded tools so an agent can summarize the active workspace, find layers, create concepts and tables, organize layers into rows, and turn rows back into canvas nodes.
project.codex_usage: Codex was used for product auditing, WebMCP architecture and implementation, schema and test generation, native browser debugging, cross-browser validation, and demo/submission preparation.
